description: Project scaffolding: Next.js App Router with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Supabase client setup, database schema SQL migrations, TypeScript types, mock data layer with all 25 students/15 classes/10 clubs/15 events/5 pods/30 messages, and core matching/AI utility functions with tests.
steps: Initialize Next.js project with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and ESLint in /projects/sandbox/CampusConnect using pnpm. Use src/ directory.

Install dependencies: @supabase/supabase-js, @supabase/ssr, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, date-fns, zustand (for client state), vitest @testing-library/react for tests.

Initialize shadcn/ui with SJSU blue (#0055A2) as primary color and gold as accent. Install these shadcn components: button, card, input, label, badge, avatar, tabs, dialog, dropdown-menu, separator, progress, textarea, select, checkbox, scroll-area, sheet, toast, skeleton.
Create tailwind config with SJSU theme: primary blue #0055A2, accent gold #E5A823, background, foreground, muted, card colors. Mobile-first breakpoints.
Create .env.example with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY placeholders and comments.
Create .env.local with empty/placeholder values so the app can run in mock mode.

Create src/types/database.ts with full TypeScript interfaces for all tables: User, Profile, Class, UserClass, Match, MatchAction, Pod, PodMember, Conversation, ConversationMember, Message, Club, Event, EventRsvp, Report, Block. Include enums for student_type, study_style, collaboration_style, connection_type, pod_type, rsvp_status, message_type, conversation_type.

Create supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql with complete CREATE TABLE statements for all 16 tables with proper foreign keys, constraints, indexes, and RLS policies. Include the exact schema from the spec.

Create supabase/migrations/002_rls_policies.sql with Row Level Security policies: users can only edit own profile, users can only read/write conversations they belong to, hidden profiles not in matching, blocked users filtered out.

Create supabase/seed.sql with INSERT statements for all seed data: 25 students with realistic SJSU profiles, 15 classes (CS 46A, CS 46B, MATH 30, ENGL 1A, BUS1 20, BIOL 30, PSYC 1, COMM 20, ENGR 10, etc.), 10 clubs (AI Club, Data Science Club, Software Engineering Society, etc.), 15 events, 5 pods, sample conversations and 30 messages.
Create src/lib/mock-data/students.ts with 25 fake student profiles with realistic data including majors, classes, interests, availability, skills, career goals, study styles.
Create src/lib/mock-data/classes.ts with 15 SJSU classes.
Create src/lib/mock-data/clubs.ts with 10 clubs.
Create src/lib/mock-data/events.ts with 15 events.
Create src/lib/mock-data/pods.ts with 5 pre-generated pods.
Create src/lib/mock-data/conversations.ts with sample direct conversations, pod conversations, and messages.
Create src/lib/mock-data/index.ts that exports all mock data and provides getter functions (getStudents, getStudentById, getClasses, etc.).
Create src/lib/supabase/client.ts - browser Supabase client (reads from env vars, returns null gracefully if not configured).
Create src/lib/supabase/server.ts - server-side Supabase client for server components.

Create src/lib/data/index.ts - data access layer that checks if Supabase is configured; if yes, queries Supabase; if no, returns mock data. Export functions: getProfile, getMatches, getPods, getConversations, getMessages, getEvents, getClubs, etc.

Create src/lib/matching/score.ts with calculateMatchScore function implementing the exact weighted scoring: shared_classes (30), same_or_related_major (20), availability_overlap (15), shared_interests (15), career_goal_similarity (10), complementary_skills (10). Returns score 0-100 with breakdown reasons.

Create src/lib/matching/pods.ts with generatePods function implementing pod scoring: shared_class_or_goal (30), availability_overlap (25), study_style_fit (15), interest_overlap (15), skill_balance (15). Groups 3-5 students by type (study, project, career, interest, event, major_switch).

Create src/lib/matching/events.ts with recommendEvents function implementing event scoring: interest_tag_match (30), major_relevance (20), career_goal_relevance (20), matches_or_pod_attending (20), availability_fit (10).
Create src/lib/matching/availability.ts with getAvailabilityOverlap and findBestMeetingTime functions. Availability is Mon-Sun with morning/afternoon/evening/late_night slots.
Create src/lib/matching/filters.ts with filterBlockedUsers, canUserAccessConversation, generateMatchReasons functions.

Create src/lib/ai/index.ts with all 5 AI helper functions: generateMatchExplanation, generateConversationStarter, generatePodExplanation, generateEventRecommendationReason, generateProfileSummary. Each checks for OPENAI_API_KEY; if missing, uses template-based deterministic fallback text. Templates must use actual match data (shared classes, interests, etc.) to form readable sentences.
Create src/lib/utils.ts with cn() helper (clsx + tailwind-merge), formatDate, formatTime, getInitials, truncate utilities.
Create tests/matching/score.test.ts testing calculateMatchScore with various student pairs.
Create tests/matching/availability.test.ts testing getAvailabilityOverlap and findBestMeetingTime.
Create tests/matching/pods.test.ts testing generatePods.
Create tests/matching/events.test.ts testing recommendEvents.
Create tests/matching/filters.test.ts testing filterBlockedUsers, canUserAccessConversation.
Configure vitest.config.ts with path aliases matching tsconfig.
Verify: run pnpm build (should succeed with no pages yet, just lib code). Run pnpm test (all matching tests should pass).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds without TypeScript errors
pnpm test runs all matching/utility tests and they pass
All 16 database tables are defined in SQL migration with proper constraints and RLS
Mock data layer returns 25 students, 15 classes, 10 clubs, 15 events, 5 pods
calculateMatchScore returns correct scores with breakdown for test pairs
AI helper functions return template text when no API key is set
findings: 1. Next.js 16.2.10 used (latest). Tailwind CSS v4 (new config format - no tailwind.config.ts, uses CSS-based theming). 2. shadcn/ui v4 - toast component deprecated, using sonner instead. 3. The mock data stores student class enrollments in a separate studentClassMap (exported from students.ts) since classes are modeled as a separate UserClass join table. 4. The project uses pnpm workspaces (pnpm-workspace.yaml was auto-generated). 5. Build output: branch is 'master' (not main). 6. All 52 tests pass, build succeeds with no TS errors. 7. context.json was not in the original git repo so it was reconstructed from kiro session snapshots.
